terminalSequence.description: A terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook: only OSC 0, 1, 2, 9, 99, 777 and BEL. Anything else makes the field ignored. Interactive sessions only, and not from an async hook.

title: WorktreeRemove hook output
description: No decision is read from JSON. Only the exit code counts: non-zero fails the removal if the directory still exists afterwards. Claude Code discards continue, systemMessage, stopReason on this event.
